candidates.title: CLO: Efficient LLM Inference System with CPU-Light KVCache Offloading via Algorithm-System Co-Design
candidates.reason: CPU-light KV offloading system with coarse head-wise GPU caching, prefetch+persistent cache, zero-copy PCIe transfer and GPU-centric synchronization; reports 9.3%-66.6% decoding-throughput improvement and releases code. Direct offload/hierarchical-memory fit.

discovery_stats.axis: CPU/GPU heterogeneous KV offload・PCIe zero-copy・GPU-centric synchronization
discovery_stats.query_summary: speculative servingからCPU/GPU heterogeneous local inferenceへ切り替えた。CLOはmillion-token KV offloadのCPU bottleneckを直接扱い、実装・実測・公開コードを持つ。canonical ID/titleをdefault branchで再検索し未収録を確認した。SwiftCache/Llumnixは既知系統として除外した。
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: serverless model loading/cold-start、NVMe model weight loading、then long-context sparse attention offloadへ移る
